# Signal Weekly — Nov 17–Nov 24, 2026

*Nov 17–Nov 24, 2026*

This week’s tech digest spotlights AI‑powered development, market automation, and hardware safety, while also covering fresh product reviews and academic breakthroughs. The mix shows how AI is reshaping both the tools we build and the devices we use.

## Tech news

- **[Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/23/anthropic-launches-claude-ship-letting-ai-agents-review-fix-and-approve-code-changes/)** (TechCrunch) — Claude Ship lets developers auto‑review, fix, and approve code, cutting deployment time.
- **[Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/23/supertake-raises-20m-to-let-ai-agents-turn-your-market-predictions-into-stock-portfolios/)** (TechCrunch) — Supertake’s AI trading platform turns market forecasts into ready‑to‑trade portfolios.
- **[States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/states-sue-spacex-to-stop-grok-from-generating-child-sex-images-revenge-porn/)** (Ars Technica) — Legal action against SpaceX highlights growing scrutiny of AI content safety.
- **[Measuring Verification Gaps In LLM-Generated Post-Quantum Hardware (Lucid, EYL)](https://semiengineering.com/measuring-verification-gaps-in-llm-generated-post-quantum-hardware-lucid-eyl/)** (SemiEngineering) — Study warns of risks when AI generates post‑quantum hardware evidence.
- **[Amazon scoops up AI accelerator tech to keep chips busy at all times](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/11/23/amazon-scoops-up-ai-accelerator-tech-to-keep-chips-busy-at-all-times/5311754)** (The Register) — Amazon’s new accelerator tech aims to keep AI chips running at peak efficiency.

## AI papers

- **[MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27973v1)** (Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu et al.) — MemOnce offers a scalable memory architecture that could keep LLMs running in real‑time.

## Reviews

- **[Your questions about Apple HomeView’s audio, answered](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038713/apple-homeview-audio-smart-speaker-spotify-airplay)** (The Verge Reviews) — Apple HomeView’s audio falls short, and app compatibility may limit smart‑home use.
- **[The Xiaomi 18 Pro proves two screens aren’t better than one](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038562/xiaomi-18-pro-max-review)** (The Verge Reviews) — Dual‑screen Xiaomi 18 Pro doesn’t deliver a clear usability win over single‑screen phones.

---

Stay tuned for more insights as AI continues to blur the lines between code, commerce, and everyday tech.
